events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second studio album, 'Imagine', was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine' – an album that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Sumner, known worldwide as Sting, the legendary frontman of The Police and successful solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sting
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Sting! From The Police classics to his incredible solo career, what's your go-to Sting track?

events.title: The first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple launched the original iPod on this day in 2001, forever changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod launched 25 years ago today, revolutionising portable music. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007 with a look back at the iconic franchise. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're reflecting on the incredible legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the master of British comedy, John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What's your top track from this iconic record?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost an icon. Remembering the unparalleled showmanship and voice of Freddie Mercury. His music lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, showcasing a new direction for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that pushed boundaries. What's your favorite song from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Starman Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the extraordinary artistry and constant reinvention of David Bowie. What's your favourite era of the Starman?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today. Remembering Elvis Presley and his undeniable impact on music and culture. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God Turns 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to guitar legend Jimmy Page! From Led Zeppelin's epic riffs to his groundbreaking production, his influence is immense. What's your favourite Page moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer Sir Rod Stewart, known for his distinctive raspy voice and string of hits, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! From Faces to his incredible solo career, what's your top Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of the iconic British ska band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Suggs
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs from Madness! From 'Our House' to 'Baggy Trousers', what's your favourite track from the Nutty Boys?
